title: Naturality of the base-change comparison with the relative Mayer–Vietoris triangles
statement: Let X' \xrightarrow{g'} X and S' \xrightarrow{g} S form a cartesian square, let f:X\to S be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let f':X'\to S' be its base change [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume moreover that S and S' are affine. Let K be in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) and let L(g')^*K\to K' be a morphism in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'}) [def-pc-derived-category]. If X=U\cup V with U and V quasi-compact open subschemes and U\cap V quasi-compact, put W'=X'\times_X W for W in {X,U,V,U\cap V}. For each such W, let \alpha_W be the canonical composite Lg^*R(f|_W)_*(K|_W)\to R(f'|_{W'})_*L(g'|_{W'})^*(K|_W)\to R(f'|_{W'})_*(K'|_{W'}), using derived pullback and direct image [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Apply Lg^*Rf_* to the derived Mayer--Vietoris triangle of K for the cover X=U\cup V, and Rf'_* to that of K' for the cover X'=U'\cup V' [lem-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-triangle], identifying Rf_*R(j_W)_* with R(f|_W)_* and Rf'_*R(j_{W'})_* with R(f'|_{W'})_*. Between the two resulting distinguished triangles in D(\mathcal O_{S'}), the maps \alpha_X, \alpha_U\oplus\alpha_V, and \alpha_{U\cap V} form a morphism of distinguished triangles.
